name: sof-gm-screen
description: Sea of Fortune GM Dashboard Google Apps Script Web App

scripts.typecheck:server: mkdir -p node_modules/.cache && cp Code.gs node_modules/.cache/Code.js && tsc --lib es2022 --types google-apps-script --noEmit --allowJs --checkJs node_modules/.cache/Code.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:md && npm run format:check && npm run audit:artifacts && npm run test && npm run knip
scripts.deploy: npm run check && clasp push -f && clasp deploy
